```lean
intro h
constructor
· intro hxy
  have : ∃ q, 0 < f q ∧ f q * |y| ≤ |x| :=
    let ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := (hf.archimedean_iff _ _).1 hxy
    exact ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩
· intro hq
  have : ArchimedeanClass.mk x ≤ ArchimedeanClass.mk y :=
    let ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := hq
    let hq' : 0 < f q := hq
    let hqy' : f q * |y| ≤ |x| := hqy
    let hqy'' : |x| ≥ f q * |y| := hqy'
    let hqy''' : |x| / |y| ≥ f q := div_le_div_right hqy'' (ne_zero_of_pos hq)
    let hqy'''' : ArchimedeanClass.mk x ≤ ArchimedeanClass.mk y :=
      ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff.2 hqy''' 
    exact hqy''''
```
